field_principles.arc_induction_audit_complete_score: Completion requires every source and prediction row to terminate.
field_principles.arc_induction_generalization_positive_sc: Credit requires leakage-free superiority above the paired interval floor.
field_principles.control_rows: Matched controls prevent a weak engine from earning credit against no baseline.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time shows how much audit work ran.
field_principles.engine_execution_rows: Fresh-process receipts show that the frozen program executed.
field_principles.engine_hash: The full digest binds results to the archived 170-line program.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for each required field makes the evidence contract reviewable.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Failed checks include expected and observed values for repair.
field_principles.generalization_gap: The prefix-minus-held-out gap exposes fit that does not transfer.
field_principles.heldout_changing_accuracy: Changing rows prevent no-op prevalence from inflating quality.
field_principles.heldout_exact_accuracy: Unshown exact predictions measure whole-transition transfer.
field_principles.heldout_noop_accuracy: No-op rows reveal hallucinated changes separately.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal prefix makes the outcome machine-classifiable.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration separates frozen engine replay from new model generation.
field_principles.level_claimed: Transition quality is not a level completion and this field must remain false.
field_principles.memorization_signature_rows: Structural and behavioral signals distinguish lookup from rules.
field_principles.paired_control_delta_rows: Paired transition deltas preserve the uncertainty unit.
field_principles.per_transition_rows: Complete source rows let reviewers recompute every metric.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact checks prevent absent live evidence from becoming an inferred result.
field_principles.prefix_exact_accuracy: Shown-row fit measures transcription and cannot prove transfer.
field_principles.prompt_hash: The prompt digest identifies what the frozen engine was allowed to see.
field_principles.purity_rows: Per-row visibility checks reveal prompt or feedback leakage.
field_principles.random_seed: The fixed seed makes the paired bootstrap reproducible.
field_principles.registry_updated: A read-only audit must not change the solve registry.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A timing-free digest detects scientific-content drift.
field_principles.rows: Run-discovery rows expose accepted and rejected candidates.
field_principles.scorer_hash: The scorer digest binds metric meaning to exact source code.
field_principles.selected_run_provenance: Environment and time select the run without using its score.
field_principles.solve_claimed: Engine quality is not a game solve and this field must remain false.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Content hashes bind every source used by the audit.
field_principles.split_rows: Explicit memberships make the shown-prefix boundary reproducible.
field_principles.submitted_to_leaderboard: Offline replay cannot imply a leaderboard submission.
field_principles.transition_hash: The transition digest detects any later row or ordering change.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents blocked or null evidence from reading as positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False records that the verifier scores observations but does not create them.
